entries.prompt: BAE Systems Hägglunds CV90120 light tank, straight left side view at eye level, on open ground in daylight, photographic reference. Same vehicle as the input photo: CV90 tracked hull with seven road wheels a side and front drive sprocket, a low angular two-man turret set over the hull centre with a long 120 mm smoothbore gun with a perforated muzzle, the commander's sight on the roof, a turret bustle. Swedish green and black splinter camouflage instead of the exhibition finish. Whole vehicle in frame, no people, no text.
